notes.title: Final Release 4th September
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!



Unfortunately, I don't think I'll be able to finish the game in time. The endings are laid out, the court is structured, and the investigation phase is almost finished.



Still, I'm afraid I won't finish it in time. My motivation is like a roller coaster, constantly going up and down from the pressure of the final push.



I really don't want to botch the game's finale, the most important and memorable part.



That's why I'm delaying it one more week for a final time.



The new, final release date is September 4.



Thank you again for understanding.

notes.title: Release delayed to August
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,



I know you hate seeing it, but I've decided to push the release back another month, to the end of August.

The reason is that I simply don't have enough time to finish the game properly. I want to make sure that the most important part of a murder mystery isn't rushed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43945198/623d4b7f6f1170476aa796a767ce1c4a54ac943f.png"]



On the bright side, I promise it will be worth the wait.

-Wegenbartho
